positions.name: CreatorReviewerEnrollment
positions.frame: How does the e2e suite encode the rule that saving a memory automatically enrolls its creator as a reviewer?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under a single directional read: src-1 states the decision that the e2e suite asserts saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer, and src-2 frames the probe memory as existing solely to carry that assertion. The relational dimension identifies an authority-ranking move — the suite assigning a role as an automatic consequence of an action — spanning both segments, while the register dimension confirms a shared flat instrumental voice across both. The conviction gradient (decision in src-1, supporting claim in src-2) is consistent: src-2 serves src-1's settled rule rather than performing a new settling.
